tools.name: receiz_v124_kai_now
tools.custody: No authority object is created; the SDK returns the genesis-derived Kai pulse coordinate.

tools.name: receiz_v124_proof_authority_challenge_create
tools.custody: The canonical signable challenge is not identity authority and must remain exact through local artifact signing.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_plan_atomic_operation
tools.custody: The SDK plan is a deterministic execution projection, not proof or commit authority.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_stage
tools.custody: The MCP runtime holds the exact SDK handle and returns only a process-local non-authoritative handleRef.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_stage_prepared
tools.custody: The MCP runtime holds the exact SDK handle and returns only a process-local non-authoritative handleRef.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_execute
tools.custody: Requires the process-local exact handle plus a local or trusted-host-persisted authority session; the canonical SDK/server path re-verifies the session and JSON reconstruction is rejected.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_resolve
tools.custody: Reads the durable authenticated execution projection through the SDK; the projection does not become proof authority.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_resolve_by_idempotency
tools.custody: Resolves the durable semantic idempotency coordinate without manufacturing or replaying a replacement plan.

tools.name: receiz_v124_execution_cancel
tools.custody: Requires the process-local exact handle plus a local or trusted-host-persisted authority session; the canonical SDK/server path re-verifies terminal authorization.

tools.name: receiz_v124_runtime_authority_session_open
tools.custody: Returns a non-authoritative local sessionRef and, when configured, a trusted-host persistedSessionRef; every later use is re-verified by the canonical SDK/server path.

tools.name: receiz_v124_runtime_authority_session_refresh
tools.custody: Refresh re-verifies a local sessionRef or trusted-host persistedSessionRef supplied as sessionRef, rotates custody, and returns new local and optional persisted references.

tools.name: receiz_v124_runtime_authority_session_close
tools.custody: Close re-verifies a local or trusted-host-persisted session reference and consumes the active session custody.

tools.name: receiz_v124_runtime_qualify
tools.custody: Capability descriptors report operational dependencies but cannot establish proof, identity, or execution authority.

tools.name: receiz_v124_domain_verified_additions
tools.custody: The SDK authenticates transport and verifies additions against the exact predecessor before admission into its replay context.

tools.name: receiz_v124_domain_verified_replay
tools.custody: Verified replay custody belongs to the canonical SDK client runtime, never to an MCP property bag.

tools.name: receiz_v124_domain_verified_checkpoint
tools.custody: Checkpoint creation consumes SDK-held verified replay custody and binds the authenticated exact head.

tools.name: receiz_v124_domain_verified_private_additions
tools.custody: The exact authenticated private-additions result remains in trusted host custody behind privateAdditionsRef; the model receives only safe coordinates, counts, and digests.

tools.name: receiz_v124_domain_replay_proof_object_export
tools.custody: Returns an unsealed non-authoritative candidate containing exactBytesB64u. It must pass the canonical Record -> Seal ceremony before admission as sealedReplayProofObjectRef.

tools.name: receiz_v124_domain_replay_proof_object_restore
tools.custody: Accepts only sealedReplayProofObjectRef, resolves the exact sealed artifact in trusted host custody, and requires canonical SDK verification before restoring replay custody.

tools.name: receiz_v124_subject_namespaces_resolve
tools.custody: Returns authenticated namespace projections bound to exact heads; projections cannot replace sealed subject truth.

tools.name: receiz_v124_identity_public_recipient_resolve
tools.custody: Returns only the privacy-safe public recipient projection needed for transfer planning; it is not identity authority.

tools.name: receiz_v124_source_publish_sealed
tools.custody: The exact sealedSourceArtifactRef stays in trusted host custody. Subject publication needs no session; replay-segment/checkpoint publication re-verifies a local or persisted session's exact stored grant.
